name: Win-Back / Reactivation Drip

parameters.content:
## Win-Back / Reactivation Drip

### How it works

1. The workflow triggers a daily check to identify leads due for win-back drip emails and builds personalized emails.
2. It checks email compliance and conditionally sends approved emails while updating the tracker or skips opted-out leads.
3. Separately, it runs a weekly summary rollup to analyze the overall campaign status of active and inactive leads.
4. The weekly summary email is built and sent out to report on the win-back campaign's performance.


### Setup steps

- - [ ] Configure Google Sheets credentials and link sheets containing the win-back tracker data.
- - [ ] Set up email credentials for sending drip and summary emails.
- - [ ] Customize the compliance check workflow and link it appropriately.
- - [ ] Schedule triggers appropriately for daily drip checks and weekly rollup summaries.

## Daily drip trigger and fetch

Scheduled trigger to start the daily win-back drip process by fetching the current win-back tracker data.

## Determine and build drip emails

Processes leads to compute which drip stage they are due for and builds personalized win-back drip emails.

## Compliance and conditional sending

Calls a compliance sub-workflow and decides to send drip emails or skip leads who opted out.

## Weekly rollup trigger and fetch

Scheduled trigger to start the weekly win-back campaign rollup summary and fetch the full tracker data.

## Compute and send weekly summary

Computes campaign summary based on tracker data, builds the weekly summary email, and sends it out.

nodes.name: Read Win-Back Tracker Sheet
nodes.notes: Reads the firm-maintained list of lost/cold leads -- your team adds rows here (or wires an intake form's 'marked lost' action to append one), this workflow never decides on its own that a lead is cold.

nodes.name: Calculate Due Drip Stage
nodes.notes: WIN_BACK_DRIP_STAGES controls the whole sequence — number of stages, spacing, and content key. A lead only advances one stage per run regardless of how many days have passed.

nodes.name: Build Win-Back Drip Email Content
nodes.notes: One templated body per stage_label — edit BODY_BY_STAGE here if you want different copy per stage (the timing itself lives in the WIN_BACK_DRIP_STAGES variable, not this code).

nodes.name: Execute Compliance Workflow
nodes.notes: Real marketing email to a real lead -- opt-out and disclaimer handling here are genuinely load-bearing, not inert like some of this catalog's internal-staff sends.

nodes.name: Send Win-Back Drip Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Win-Back Drip Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Update Tracker With Sent Stage
nodes.notes: Only updates last_stage_sent and last_sent_at -- matched on lead_id, so this never touches the other columns (name, email, status, etc.) a firm maintains directly.

nodes.name: Skip Drip Email Lead Opted Out
nodes.notes: Opted out via the guardrail's own opt-out list -- doesn't advance the tracker's stage, but also doesn't retry; mark the lead 'unsubscribed' in the tracker sheet directly to stop future attempts cleanly.

nodes.name: Read Complete Win-Back Tracker
nodes.notes: Reads every lead in the tracker, regardless of status.

nodes.name: Summarize Weekly Win-Back Status
nodes.notes: completed_sequence_count flags active leads who've already received every configured stage — worth a manual decision on what (if anything) to do next.

nodes.name: Build Weekly Win-Back Email
nodes.notes: Internal, firm-wide summary — no guardrail wrap needed, matching this catalog's other weekly rollups.

nodes.name: Send Weekly Win-Back Email
nodes.notes: Internal, firm-wide summary — no guardrail wrap needed.

main.node: Skip Drip Email Lead Opted Out

description: Runs daily: reads a firm-maintained tracker of lost/cold leads, works out which stage of a configured drip sequence each active lead is due for based on days since going cold (catching up automatically if a run is missed), sends a templated re-engagement email through the Bar-Compliance Guardrail, and updates the tracker with the stage sent. Separately, a weekly rollup reports active/reactivated/unsubscribed counts and flags leads who've completed the whole sequence. Never decides a lead is unreachable on its own -- opting out or marking reactivated is always a manual, firm-driven decision. Replaces Lawmatics for this specific use case.
